details: Batch for Fri Nov 27 sent, waiting for approval
summary: Of the 35 trial reels posted in the last 7 days (Nov 20 to 26), 14 can be counted; the other 21 show next to no views. The 14 drew 4,322 views in total, typically about 137 each. The typical 3-second hold is 17.6%, down from 18.7% the week before. In the current test, O1 (a number fact written over the book) holds 21.8% on 172 views and O6 (the book's spine shown first) holds 17.4% on 368 views, so O1 is 4.4 points ahead so far, but both samples are under 500 views and too small to mean anything yet. Best recent reel by 3-second hold: The Sealed Nectar at 24.6%. Worst: Al-Mutoon al-Jami'ah at 11.0%. Today's batch is a third day of the same test, O1 against O6, on five different books.
change: The fifth test was not decided today: O1 (a number fact written over the book) and O6 (the book's spine shown first) each have under 500 views after two days, too few to judge, so a third day runs today and the decision moves to Sat Nov 28. The fourth test is now final: O1 stays champion; O5 (an edition fact written over the book) ended 3.7 points of 3-second hold ahead on 918 views, short of the 8 points needed, and gets no rematch. Nothing in the formula changes.
